# uptimeify_im_statuspage_rule (Data Source)

Look up one Incident Management status page rule by numeric id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_im_statuspage_rule" "acme" {
  id = "17"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric rule id.

### Read-Only

- `auto_resolve` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String)
- `min_severity` (String)
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `status_page_id` (Number)
- `target_state` (String)
- `team_id` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
